title: 第23章 叶皇秘令第24章 不死帝族猎十七
content_zh:
按照战天塔的规则，打赢之后叶天应该退出，或者下降一级。
而胜利者林玄，可以在这里休息片刻。
不过，林玄并未驱赶对方。
“叶皇，借宝地一用！”
“用吧，反正你打赢了，本皇应该把这里让给你的。”叶天说道。
“不必，我还会继续挑战，叶皇不必离开。”
“你真要继续挑战？”叶天眼前一亮，顿时兴奋起来。
虽然他也劝林玄不去挑战，但实际上，他还是有些期待的。
那两个家伙，是他当年唯二无法打败的人。
林玄若能打败他们，某种程度上，也算弥补了他的遗憾。
但那两人实在太强了，林玄哪有机会？
此时，林玄已经吃下一颗丹药炼化起来。
叶天发现，这是一颗银色丹药，只是林玄半遮半掩的，无法看清楚。
这正是林玄用银瞳妖狮炼制的丹药，一共五颗。
林玄吃下一颗，补充刚才的消耗，随后又炼化四颗，玄气又有所增长，增幅三成上下。
“林玄，你的身后有一名强大的丹师吧？”叶天问道。
“何出此言？”
“这还用问吗？你的实力比本皇当年更强，没有强大的丹师支撑，怎么可能？”
以皇族的恐怖资源，才造就了叶天当年的风采。
而境界更低，实力却更强的林玄，背后肯定有一个水准超高的丹师。

“你绝非普通的天才，除了丹师之外，应该还有一个强大的势力支撑，本皇猜得没错吧？”
“算是吧。”林玄没有解释太多，有些事解释得越清楚就越麻烦，模棱两可更好。
“本皇就知道，你绝不是一般人，难怪一颗玄华丹还嫌少，他日来炎京，丹药、法宝本皇任你挑！”
“那就提前感谢叶皇了！”
林玄拱手一笑，告别叶皇，向九十八层走去。
大厅里，众人还沉浸在震撼之中！
“叶皇打输了竟然还很开心，甚至还赏赐丹药给林玄？”
“不愧是我大炎皇朝的帝王，叶皇的胸怀真是无比宽广！”
“赢得起也输得起，这才是帝王风范！”
众人被叶皇的举动征服，有人甚至激动得热泪盈眶。
“这个叶皇，竟然在战斗傀儡里藏了一颗丹药，观玄阁上下竟无人察觉，皇族的手段，还真是了得！”
content_en:
According to the rules of the Battle Tower, after winning the battle, Ye Tian should quit or drop down a level.
The winner, Lin Xuan, can rest here for a while.
However, Lin Xuan did not drive the other party away.
"Emperor Ye, borrow the treasure land and use it!"
"Use it. Anyway, if you win, I should give this place to you." Ye Tian said.
"No, I will continue to challenge. Emperor Ye doesn't have to leave."
"Do you really want to continue the challenge?" Ye Tian's eyes lit up and he suddenly became excited.
Although he also advised Lin Xuan not to challenge, in fact, he still had some expectations.
Those two guys were the only two people he couldn't defeat back then.
Lin Xuanruo's ability to defeat them made up for his regrets to a certain extent.
But those two people were too strong, how could Lin Xuan stand a chance?
At this time, Lin Xuan had already taken a pill and refined it.
Ye Tian discovered that this was a silver pill, but Lin Xuan was half-hidden and could not see it clearly.
This is exactly the elixir that Lin Xuan refined with the silver-eyed demon lion. There are five pills in total.
Lin Xuan ate one pill to replenish his previous consumption, and then refined four more pills. His profound energy increased again, by about 30%.
"Lin Xuan, is there a powerful alchemist behind you?" Ye Tian asked.
"Why do you say that?"
"Do you still need to ask? You are stronger than I was back then. How could it be possible without the support of a powerful alchemist?"
It was the terrifying resources of the royal family that created Ye Tian's style back then.
Lin Xuan, who was at a lower level but stronger, must have a very high-level alchemist behind him.
"You are by no means an ordinary genius. In addition to the alchemy master, you should also have the support of a powerful force. Is my guess right?"
"That's right." Lin Xuan didn't explain too much. The clearer the explanation for some things, the more troublesome it will be. It's better to be vague.
"I know that you are by no means an ordinary person. No wonder one Xuanhua Pill is not enough. When you come to Yanjing one day, I will let you choose the pills and magic weapons!"
"Then thank you Emperor Ye in advance!"
Lin Xuan cupped his hands and smiled, bid farewell to Ye Huang, and walked towards the ninety-eighth floor.
In the hall, everyone was still immersed in shock!
"Ye Huang was actually very happy after losing, and even rewarded Lin Xuan with pills?"
"As expected of the emperor of my Dayan Dynasty, Emperor Ye's mind is so broad!"
"You can win but you can also lose. This is the style of an emperor!"
Everyone was conquered by Ye Huang's actions, and some were even moved to tears.
"This Emperor Ye actually hid a pill in the battle puppet, and no one in Guanxuan Pavilion noticed it. The royal family's methods are really amazing!"
